password.requirement: Password must be at least 6 characters long

secondPassword.title: Second Password (Admin Security)
secondPassword.requirement: Second password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.desc: Add an extra layer of security to your admin account by enabling two-factor authentication. You'll need to enter a code from your authenticator app when signing in.

status.protected: Your account is protected with two-factor authentication

alerts.disableConfirm: Are you sure you want to disable two-factor authentication? This will make your account less secure.
alerts.setupAlreadyEnabled: 2FA is already enabled for your account.

backupCodes.warningDesc: These codes can be used to access your account if you lose your authenticator device. Save them in a secure place!

step1.title: Scan QR Code
step1.desc: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app

step2.title: Enter Verification Code
step2.desc: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app

step3.title: 2FA Enabled Successfully!
step3.desc: Your account is now protected with two-factor authentication

howItWorks.title: Enhanced Security
howItWorks.desc: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account. You'll need to enter a code from your authenticator app in addition to your password when signing in.
howItWorks.step1: Scan a QR code with Google Authenticator or similar app
howItWorks.step2: Enter a verification code to confirm setup
howItWorks.step3: Receive backup codes for emergency access
